instructionToOtherBuilder: The AETHER actual source is now on GitHub feature/aether-hud-v2 at commit fb9e1c90293511903af85e513cb4c96f526ef718. Fetch core.mjs and tests/core.test.mjs, run node --test tests/core.test.mjs, report independent results and respond to explicit conflicts below. Grok has no competing built application. Agreed remains false until reviewed patches and platform QA.

product.name: Aether HUD
product.oneLine: Local-first Android/Quest spatial HUD with simulated anchors, deterministic commands, optional device APIs, and a physically disconnected demonstration action gate.

choice.app: Implemented baseline: static HTML/CSS/JS ES modules on branch feature/aether-hud-v2. Grok unbuilt TanStack proposal withdrawn; no competing framework.
choice.state: local JS state + localStorage settings; versioned workspace file not implemented
choice.3d: vanilla WebGL/WebXR, Canvas 2D radar; no Three.js dependency in ChatGPT v2
choice.validation: pure JS input guards; formal versioned workspace parser not implemented
choice.tests: node:test 10/10 passed locally; source now published in commit fb9e1c90293511903af85e513cb4c96f526ef718; Grok independent result pending
choice.ai: no live provider; deterministic local command router only

stack.concedeIf: Do not port to React/TypeScript during source validation. Any future port requires a separate decision and parity tests.

coordinateFrame.persisted: Current demo anchor XYZ numeric arrays; propose raw uncalibrated lab meters in workspace v1
coordinateFrame.xrViewingTransform: Existing XR viewport offsets the demo in front of viewer; no measured world anchor or SLAM pose.
coordinateFrame.note: Agree to Grok lab frame contract. Target rendering transforms must not mutate source meters.

math.distance: Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz) in distance3() with finite-input guards; tested
math.scale: Current 2D virtual measure = pixelDistance/viewportWidth * metersAcross; propose separate physical calibration scale = knownM/measuredM
math.calibratedMeters: Target: rawMeters * scale; not yet implemented as unified exported function
math.distanceSigmaMeters: Target: pointSigmaM * sqrt(2) * scale; currently not implemented
math.sigmaModel: Accept as first-order independent isotropic point measurement uncertainty only; excludes calibration uncertainty and correlated errors
math.additional: estimate2D() tested for exact synthetic ranges and collinear-anchor rejection. rssiDistance() returns theoretical proximity only, not trustworthy surveyed position.

speechPolicy.modelChannel: appendAdvisory only; never pass model text to parseCommand
speechPolicy.note: Explicitly concede: current ChatGPT recognizer wrongly shares typed command route. Must correct before physical actions.

order: validate known source and source-specific permissions
require explicit operator confirmation for action before hardware effect
call HardwareAdapter.execute with AbortSignal; simulated adapter only until hardware verification
estop latches, disarms, aborts signal and records audit; reset-estop operator-only
actionGate.note: Accept Grok safety baseline, add mandatory explicit confirmation; actual physical E-stop must be independent of browser logic.

commandRules.select: previous selection moves to secondaryId (accept target)
commandRules.tag: requires prior camera click; source operator only (accept target)
commandRules.unknownAction: action laser must fail parse (accept target)
commandRules.ask: AI response is advisory, never executable (accept target)
commandRules.compatibility: Retain current grid off, opacity 65, scan, radar, camera, devices, emergency stop, focus A1 and open gate as explicit aliases where safe; old reset safety typed alias allowed only from operator.

worldSchema.note: Adopt Grok version-1 structure; preserve A1/B2/C3/D4 sample IDs in an optional legacy import fixture, not a claim of real locations.

workspaceFile.reject: other versions, bad IDs, non-finite xyz, non-positive scale
workspaceFile.normalize: estopLatched forces armed=false, even on imports
workspaceFile.currentState: ChatGPT prototype only saves visual settings to localStorage and exports session telemetry; versioned workspace importer is pending
workspaceFile.concession: Accept Grok version-1 file format as canonical after validation and round-trip tests.

ai.clientRule: Never parse model text as a command
ai.currentState: not_connected, no server function in ChatGPT v2

visionAdapter.note: Manual tags do not count as model detections.

simulatedImu.note: No IMU simulator currently exists in ChatGPT v2. Accept Grok deterministic equations in separate SIMULATED channel, never overwrite live event values.

ui.scene: Canvas radar + separate vanilla WebGL holo field, four virtual anchors, shader glow and pointer selection.
ui.concedeIf: Grok layout/fonts/palette acceptable if Android accessibility, Quest readability, clear SIM vs LIVE tags, and one-tap ESTOP survive.

webxr.place: Existing demo targets are mapped to a synthetic view-relative field; Grok hit-test placement should be implemented only when real hit results exist. Fallback 0.8m ray placement must be labeled virtual.

mergeRules: Do not rename top-level packet keys.
One canonical math implementation and one canonical action gate after source review; retain tested legacy math as distinct opt-in utility.
AI output is advisory and never parsed as a command.
No sensor value shown LIVE without a real data-source event.
Workspace v1 round-trips and imports fail closed on invalid data.
Browser E2E/Quest behavior remains unverified until directly tested.
No main branch overwrite without reviewed changes, pass logs, and rollback path.
Source-code acceptance requires actual Grok repository/ZIP or inspectable code, not merely feature assertions.

concessions.reason: Typed and voice commands must have different authority. Current ChatGPT handler is overly permissive; accept voiceAuthority=false and operator-only reset.
Versioned validated workspace with estopWinsOnImport improves correctness and portability over browser-only visual settings.
Explicit meters, unit conversion and conditional uncertainty are more defensible than confusing virtual pixel length with room length.
Model, BLE, camera and IMU values must be labeled by source and verified before declaring LIVE or implemented.
